project_type: pnpm 9.12 monorepo: apps/api (NestJS 10 + Prisma 5 + BullMQ worker), apps/web (Next.js 14 App Router, React 18), packages/shared (plain TS, zod 3.23.8 only), new apps/mobile (Expo SDK 57, RN 0.86.3, React 19.2.3, CNG dev build)
build_system: pnpm workspaces (apps/*, packages/*), default isolated node_modules, NO .npmrc and no hoisting. apps/api typechecks/builds against @belzo/shared DIST (apps/api/tsconfig.json paths:{}), so run `pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build` after any shared source change before api typecheck/build. Web resolves shared from source (tsconfig paths + transpilePackages). API/web Jest map @belzo/shared to packages/shared/src/index.ts. Mobile resolves shared from source in tsc (paths), Jest (moduleNameMapper) and Metro (resolveRequest). Mobile has NO build and NO dev script.
test_framework: Jest 29: ts-jest in api (*.spec.ts), web and shared (*.test.ts); jest-expo 57.0.5 + @testing-library/react-native 14.1.0 in apps/mobile
build_command: pnpm --filter @belzo/shared build && pnpm --filter @belzo/api db:generate && pnpm -r build
test_command: pnpm -r typecheck && pnpm -r lint && pnpm -r test
verification_instructions: Per package: `pnpm --filter <pkg> typecheck|lint|test` (api also `build`, web also `build`). Targeted api specs: `pnpm --filter @belzo/api test -- <pattern>`. Full sweep = design.md §16.2 steps 1-9 = plan.md item 25. Mobile extra checks run from apps/mobile: `npx expo config --type public` (dev, and with APP_VARIANT=production + EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=https://shop.example.com), `npx expo-doctor@1.20.4`, `npx expo prebuild -p android --no-install --clean` (delete android/ afterwards), `npx expo export --platform android --output-dir dist --source-maps` with packages/shared/dist temporarily renamed (always restore), `node apps/mobile/scripts/check-easignore.mjs`. Isolation proof: Docker deps-stage simulation in %TEMP% for api and web (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, assert no react-native@/expo@/metro@ in node_modules/.pnpm), filtered `pnpm install --filter "@belzo/api..." --filter "@belzo/web..." --frozen-lockfile --dry-run`, deploy tarball listing has zero apps/mobile entries. CI YAML parse: `pnpm exec prettier .github/workflows/ci.yml > $null`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: pnpm-lock.yaml (committed; only the apps/mobile importer + new packages may be added — api/web/shared importer blocks must not change). apps/mobile/src/ui/brand/belzo-logo.generated.ts (from `pnpm --filter @belzo/mobile brand:sync`) and apps/mobile/assets/placeholder/*-PLACEHOLDER.png (from `pnpm --filter @belzo/mobile assets:placeholder`) are committed. NEVER commit apps/mobile/android/, apps/mobile/dist/, apps/mobile/.expo/, packages/shared/dist/.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell (use `;` or separate calls, quote paths). Node 24.12.0, pnpm 9.12.0, JDK 17. npm registry reachable. Docker CLI installed but daemon NOT running — skip docker build and report. NO Android SDK/adb/emulator: do NOT install one; no APK/AAB can be built; EAS needs the owner's Expo account (never run eas build). Work directly in c:\xampp\htdocs\Belzo on master: no worktree, no branch, never push, never deploy. ~200 pre-existing untracked paths exist: do not commit them (only the item-0 baseline list). Never stage .env* (apps/web/.env.local, .env), *.pem (Belzo-key.pem), *.jks, *.keystore, google-services.json, or anything under .agents/, .kiro/, aidlc-docs/. Add files to git explicitly by path.
contribution_requirements: Design is authoritative (.agents/tasks/mobile-app/design.md, approved iteration 4); do not redesign. Web behaviour must stay byte-identical with no X-Client-Platform header (except the deliberate A2-A7 fixes). No edits under apps/web/src/app/** for the helper extraction. Exact dependency pins from design §12; no react-native-razorpay, no expo-notifications, no gesture-handler/reanimated, no axios. Commit messages per design §17 / plan.md (Conventional Commits), one commit per backend change. Tests land with each change.
key_patterns: API: controllers use createZodDto (apps/api/src/modules/identity/zod-dto.ts) + global ZodValidationPipe; @Public() opt-out of the deny-by-default JWT guard; cart identity via resolveCartRef(req, this.tokens) in cart-context.ts; QueueService is @Global (common/queue/queue.module.ts) with QUEUES in queue.constants.ts; existing spec patterns: token.service.spec.ts (makeFakePrisma in-memory fake), checkout.service.spec.ts (build() helper with fake cart/pricing), cart.service.spec.ts. Refresh cookie helpers in identity/refresh-cookie.ts. Shared: modules re-exported from packages/shared/src/index.ts; tests are *.test.ts with ts-jest under tsconfig.base.json (noUncheckedIndexedAccess). Web lib modules in apps/web/src/lib become thin re-exports (isolatedModules: use `type` modifiers). Mobile: layering screens → feature hooks (TanStack Query) → feature api.ts → src/api core; '@/...' alias = apps/mobile/src.
directory_structure: apps/api/src/{common,modules/{identity,cart,checkout,engagement,orders,...},integrations}; apps/web/src/{app/(shop),app/admin,lib,components}; packages/shared/src (money, constants, schemas, catalogue, pricing, orders, order-tracking, returns, wallet, reporting, gst, bulk-sheet + new format, attributes, price-breakup, order-view, home); apps/mobile (new; layout in design §1.2: src/{app,config,api,navigation,theme,ui,store,lib,features/*}, plugins/, scripts/, assets/placeholder/, __tests__/). Task docs in .agents/tasks/mobile-app (untracked, never committed).
